Title: Hidden strength and strike resolution for allies

Messages.Author: Louhi
Messages.Body:
If an ally were to play a hidden strength so it would burn, will the strike of the ally be resolved? For example a reanimated corpse gets hit for one and uses its hand strike. Then during strike resolution a hidden strength for two blood is played by the corpse, will the hand strike for two be resolved or will the corpse just burn straight up first?

Hidden Strength
Type: Combat
Requires: Fortitude
Cost: X blood
[for] Prevent X+1 damage.
[FOR] As above, with an optional press.

Lidingö Scourge

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: Yes the strike will be resolved (assuming the opponent didn't strike with first strike) as damage prevention is after strike resolution.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Klaital wrote:
> Yes the strike will be resolved (assuming the opponent didn't strike with first strike) as damage prevention is after strike resolution.
>
Damage prevention is part of strike resolution ( Complete Rules Reference VI.C.2 ). However, damage inflicted must be handled (prevent or heal / avoid destruction).

So you burn the Reanimated Corpse, and the opponent has to deal with the 2 damage.
